d: COP31 has ended without a cover decision after nearly 200 countries failed to bridge deep divisions over fossil fuels and climate finance. Negotiations in Antalya ran more than 40 hours beyond the scheduled close. The European Union, Panama and several other countries rejected the proposed text because it did not explicitly strengthen language on moving away from fossil fuels. Others resisted including such language at all. Australia’s Chris Bowen, who led the negotiations, eventually admitted that the competing red lines had become impossible to reconcile.
